description: Detect reference logos and image elements in a flat design and remove them: the text-free base image is saved, the detected layers come back with the reference each matched (REF_0, REF_1, … in the order given). The design and the references as local files or public https URLs. No price quote (the v1 operation offers no dry run).

design_image.description: The flat design to analyze for logos, a local file or a public https URL

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

reference_images.description: Local image files (or public https URLs) of the logos to match in the design, REF_0, REF_1, … in the order given (at most 10)

name: ideogram_layerize_logos
title: Layerize logos
